DIVINITY KETHRANI WARDING

The protective passages spread across your arms and chest whenever another creature is threatened.
When you use Warding Word upon an ally, that ally also gains Resistance to the triggering.

Prerequisites Tharos heritage, Interlocking Script, Level 10

Works automatically: Warding Word's Use also puts Resistance on the ally for the round. The book's sentence ends "Resistance to the triggering" — the damage type of the triggering attack is assumed; flagged for Graham.
